reviews.text: Always an excellent job!
They do a great job with our 2nd super large dog. Wife swears by them and dog come out super clean

Been bringing my poodle Gigi to Lucky Tails for over 2 years and I have never had a single bad experience. They always groom her exactly the way I want (or better) , all the girls are incredibly warm and sweet and friendly. My forever go-to groomer ❤️

I’ve been bringing my dog from Haarlem to Amsterdam for a couple of years now, and I couldn’t be happier with the service at Lucky Tails.

My dog isn’t easy—he doesn’t let just anyone pet him and can be quite difficult to handle. I’ve tried many groomers before, but none of them were the right fit. That’s why I’m so happy I found the team at Lucky Tails.

Every three months, I bring him here, and each time the experience is consistently great. They are patient, professional, and truly know how to work with sensitive and challenging dogs.

I completely trust them with my dog and highly recommend their services to anyone looking for skilled and caring groomers.

Every time a great result. My dog is always so nervous when we come here, but only because of the way he is, and regardless he is received with a lot of love and patience from the lovely staff of Lucky Tails. Us pet parents are so blessed to have Lucky Tails in Amsterdam!
First time using this groomer and thoroughly impressed. Very friendly staff, nice facility and they did an excellent job. We will definitely be back.

I went here specifically, but the results with my Australian Shepherd are actually unsatisfactory. I understand what they did, hence the 3 stars, but this should really be 2! I much prefer going to my old place. Besides, I feel like they don't have much experience with larger dogs.

I have tried a few groomers in Amsterdam (some cheaper, some a similar price), but I have to say that Lucky Tails are hands down the best. My dog always leaves looking so, so much better, and they’re very thorough (some other places miss spots / leave some areas uneven). The attention to detail is great, plus they’re really lovely and always kind - even if I have let my dog get a little knotty, they’re never judgemental (which I appreciate a lot!). He’s always really calm and happy leaving there too. Would recommend.

It's average services. Not shaved on the belly, on the bottom and under their pawn.  You really can see the difference between professional and amateur company in this universe. If you looking something really average, go there

I have been taking my dog, Chuckle, to Lucky Tails for about a year now, and I couldn’t be happier with the care they provide. The team truly goes above and beyond to make sure Chuckle is well looked after. They take the time to communicate with me, and whenever I have concerns (like when I worry about his breathing), they send me reassuring pictures showing that he’s doing fine. I really appreciate their thoughtful and considerate approach.

Having seen how my other dog was treated by another groomer, I can confidently say that Lucky Tails stands out in terms of skill and care. I trust them completely with Chuckle, and I highly recommend them!
Very happy with lucky tails , the have done a wonderfull job!!! 🥰 …
Recommended saloon, very clear communication and our toy poodle always comes out looking amazing.
Over the moon that I found lucky tails! They’ve done an excellent job of hand striping my boy and really took the time to explain the process and next steps. Thank you ladies!
Had our best groom yet! Always happy with the results at Lucky Tails 😊 …

We are very happy with the Lucky Tails grooming service. The staff are friendly and helpful and listen to instructions and follow them. Our dog Grace an Irish Setter was given a bath and trimmed and after the treatment she looked absolutely lovely.
Thank you Lucky Tails and you’ll be seeing us soon!
My dog looks really good after the haircut :) Thank you!
Very professional.
Highly recommended! Extremely professional team, and my (dramatic) dog were treated with a lot of affection and care. Definitely coming back!
Had our first grooming today at lucky tails, my girl was returned in a good mood and nicely groomed.

DO NOT GO! The dogs come back frightened, as if they have been humiliated for hours. Fearful of everything and everyone for a whole week. Scandalous. Anus plucked without consultation and whining while he sleeps. The lady from the Eastern Bloc grabbed him unnecessarily hard by the skin when I came to pick him up. Once again, DO NOT GO.
